description:
Get QTL colocalization evidence from L2G features.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table colocalisation_ecaviar — one record = one eCAVIAR colocalisation test between two credible sets.
Key: leftStudyLocusId, rightStudyLocusId.
Arguments: study_locus_id accepts study locus id (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by clpp desc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Rows with unknown clpp are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. eCAVIAR tests run by OT 25.09 between overlapping credible sets; absence means not tested.
CLPP values come from the eCAVIAR colocalisation tests; qtl_type is an exact study type. Gene-level queries are not answerable from these tables.

schema.description: Pass at least one of: study_locus_id.

min_clpp.description: Keeps rows with clpp >= this value; unknown values never pass. Defaults to 0.5; pass null for no restriction.

study_locus_id.description: Accepts study_locus_id; resolved to one study_locus_id (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
